examples.en: Monks gathered inside the cathedral chapterhouse every morning to discuss daily duties.
examples.zh: 僧侣们每天早晨聚集在大教堂附属会议厅讨论日常事务。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chapterhouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a charge added at a restaurant for every bottle of wine served that was not bought on the premises

examples.en: The upscale restaurant charges a modest corkage fee if guests bring wine.
examples.zh: 这家高档餐厅如果客人自带葡萄酒，会收取适额开瓶费。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 corkage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 清炖汤, 清炖鸡汤, 清炖肉汤
lemmas.def_en: clear soup usually of beef or veal or chicken

examples.en: The waiter served a steaming bowl of clear beef consomme first.
examples.zh: 服务员首先端上了一碗热气腾腾的清澈牛肉清汤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 consomme 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (mineralogy) a star-shaped figure with six rays that is seen in some crystal structures under reflected or transmitted light

examples.en: The Big Dipper is perhaps the most widely recognized asterism visible tonight.
examples.zh: 北斗七星大概是今晚可见的最广为人知的星群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 asterism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman who is a member of a committee

examples.en: The experienced committeewoman voiced serious concerns regarding the newly proposed budget.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的女委员对新提出的预算案表达了深切担忧。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 committeewoman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 下层自由民, 中世纪的农民, 出身低贱的人, 乡下人, 粗暴的人, 吝啬鬼, 守财奴
lemmas.def_en: a crude uncouth ill-bred person lacking culture or refinement

examples.en: The wealthy lord treated the poor churl with cruelty and utter disdain.
examples.zh: 富有的领主残忍且极度蔑视地对待那个贫穷的农夫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 churl 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a restaurant that specializes in steaks

examples.en: They decided to celebrate their success with prime steaks at a traditional chophouse.
examples.zh: 他们决定在一家传统排骨餐馆享用上等牛排来庆祝成功。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chophouse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: British slang (dated) for a prison

examples.en: The petty thief spent a miserable weekend locked away in the local chokey.
examples.zh: 那个小偷在当地的拘留所里度过了一个凄惨的周末。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chokey 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: gum-like substance from the sapodilla

examples.en: Traditionally, natural chicle harvested from sapodilla trees was used to make chewing gum.
examples.zh: 传统上，从人心果树中采集的天然糖胶树胶用于制作口香糖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chicle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flowing together

examples.en: The ancient trading town was established at the conflux of two major rivers.
examples.zh: 这座古老的商贸城镇建立在两条大河的汇流处。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 conflux 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a United States unit of weight equivalent to 100 pounds

examples.en: The merchant purchased another cental of wheat to supply his bustling bakery.
examples.zh: 这位商人又购入了一百磅小麦以供应他门庭若市的面包店。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cental 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a shop where books are sold

examples.en: She picked up a magazine at the train station bookstall before her departure.
examples.zh: 她在出发前去火车站的书报摊买了一本杂志。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bookstall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (+ up) (North American slang) To mess up, botch, or throw a plan into confusion.

examples.en: A single software glitch managed to completely bollix the entire scheduling system.
examples.zh: 一个小小的软件故障把整个排程系统彻底搞砸了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bollix 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人困惑地, 使人昏乱地
lemmas.def_en: in a bewildering and confusing manner

examples.en: The plot of the mystery novel became bewilderingly complex in its final chapters.
examples.zh: 这部悬疑小说的情节在最后几章变得复杂得令人困惑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bewilderingly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a tasteless colorless powder used medicinally as a cathartic

examples.en: Doctors in the nineteenth century frequently prescribed calomel despite its high mercury toxicity.
examples.zh: 尽管甘汞具有高汞毒性，19世纪的医生仍经常开这种药。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 calomel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 装有万向接头[平衡架] 的
lemmas.def_en: supported on gimbals and remaining steady or level when the base tips

examples.en: The drone carries a gimbaled camera that stays remarkably stable in strong winds.
examples.zh: 这架无人机搭载了一个在强风中仍能保持极其稳定的万向节相机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gimbaled 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an employee of a railroad

examples.en: The courteous trainman inspected our tickets and helped an elderly passenger with luggage.
examples.zh: 礼貌的列车员检查了我们的车票，并帮一位老人拿行李。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trainman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of chemistry that studies the relation between chemical action and the amount of heat absorbed or generated

examples.en: Students in the chemistry lab used thermochemistry principles to calculate the reaction heat.
examples.zh: 化学实验室的学生利用热化学原理解算了反应热。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thermochemistry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 同时发生, [the]历史人物和事件的编年表, 同步性
lemmas.def_en: the relation that exists when things occur at the same time

examples.en: The dance performance relied heavily on the precise synchronism of light and music.
examples.zh: 这场舞蹈表演极其依赖灯光与音乐的精确同步。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 synchronism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: haveing a valence of four

examples.en: Carbon is a tetravalent element capable of forming four stable covalent bonds.
examples.zh: 碳是一种四价元素，能够形成四个稳定的共价键。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tetravalent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [亦作T-][化]塔崩(一种神经性毒剂)
lemmas.def_en: the first known nerve agent, synthesized by German chemists in 1936; a highly toxic combustible liquid that is soluble in organic solvents and is used as a nerve gas in chemical warfare

examples.en: The deadly chemical agent tabun was strictly banned under international arms treaties.
examples.zh: 致命化学毒剂塔崩已被国际军控条约严格禁止。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tabun 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the lower side of anything

examples.en: Inspectors found severe rust developing rapidly on the undersurface of the metal bridge.
examples.zh: 检查人员发现金属桥梁的底面上正迅速生出严重铁锈。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undersurface 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small or narrow cell

examples.en: After the intense workout, he relaxed inside the heated sweatbox to flush toxins.
examples.zh: 剧烈运动后，他在发汗箱内放松以排出毒素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sweatbox 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a word that is written with three letters in an alphabetic writing system

examples.en: The letter combination 'tch' serves as a common trigram in the English language.
examples.zh: 字母组合‘tch’在英语中是一个常见的三字母一音。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trigram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 庸人, 俗人, 暴发户
lemmas.def_en: a vulgar person (especially someone who makes a vulgar display of wealth)

examples.en: Despite his immense newfound wealth, he was dismissed by high society as a vulgarian.
examples.zh: 尽管暴富，他仍被上流社会视为粗俗鄙陋之徒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vulgarian 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 令人不快地；不受欢迎地
lemmas.def_en: in an undesirable manner

examples.en: Excess moisture accumulated in the warehouse, undesirably spoiling the stored grain supplies.
examples.zh: 仓库积聚了过多湿气，令人不快地毁坏了储存的粮食储备。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 undesirably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not performed

examples.en: The composer left behind several unperformed symphonies in his private music archives.
examples.zh: 这位作曲家在私人音乐档案中留下了几部从未公演过的交响曲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unperformed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 粘的, 胶粘的, 粘质的
lemmas.def_en: having the sticky properties of an adhesive

examples.en: The snail left a viscid trail of mucus across the damp garden stone.
examples.zh: 蜗牛在潮湿的花园石路上留下一道粘稠的粘液痕迹。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 viscid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a band of cloth or leather or metal links attached to a wristwatch and wrapped around the wrist

examples.en: He replaced his worn leather watchband with a durable stainless steel one.
examples.zh: 他用耐用的不锈钢表带替换了磨损的旧皮表带。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 watchband 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 捕鲸小艇, 尖尾长艇
lemmas.def_en: a long narrow boat designed for quick turning and use in rough seas

examples.en: The sturdy wooden whaleboat was swiftly lowered into the water to pursue the pod.
examples.zh: 那艘坚固的木制捕鲸小艇被迅速放入水中追击鲸群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whaleboat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [鸟]黄莺科的小鸟, 麻雀的一种
lemmas.def_en: Old World warbler similar to the greater whitethroat but smaller

examples.en: A common whitethroat was singing its cheerful song from the thick hawthorn hedge.
examples.zh: 一只白喉林莺在茂密的山楂树篱上唱着欢快的歌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 whitethroat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使作伪证, 唆使, 怂恿, 收买
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (law / formal) To bribe or secretly persuade someone to commit an illegal act, especially perjury in court.

examples.en: The corrupt lawyer attempted to suborn the key witness with a large bribe.
examples.zh: 这位腐败的律师企图用巨额贿赂唆使关键证人作伪证。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 suborn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a set sequence of steps, part of larger computer program

examples.en: The main software code calls this specific subprogram whenever a calculation is required.
examples.zh: 每当需要计算时，主软件代码就会调用这个特定的子程序。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subprogram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: wale at the top of the side of boat; topmost planking of a wooden vessel

examples.en: He leaned carefully over the wooden gunnel to pull his fishing net inside.
examples.zh: 他小心地倚在木质船舷上，把渔网拉了进来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gunnel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tending to check bleeding by contracting the tissues or blood vessels

examples.en: The barber quickly applied a styptic pencil to soothe the minor shaving cut.
examples.zh: 理发师迅速涂抹了止血笔，以缓解刮脸造成的小划伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 styptic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a congenital cleft in the middle of the upper lip

examples.en: The skilled surgeon successfully corrected the infant's congenital harelip during a delicate operation.
examples.zh: 精湛的外科医生通过微创手术成功矫正了婴儿的先天性兔唇。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 harelip 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: rigged with a triangular (lateen) sail

examples.en: Traditional fishing vessels with lateen sails glided gracefully across the tranquil Mediterranean harbor.
examples.zh: 挂着大三角帆的传统渔船在宁静的地中海港湾中优雅滑行。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lateen 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (因饮酒过度而造成的)头痛, 宿酲, 恶心, 苦恼, 抑郁, 沮丧, 吵闹
lemmas.def_en: disagreeable aftereffects from the use of drugs (especially alcohol)

examples.en: After the wild celebration, he woke up with a pounding katzenjammer that lasted hours.
examples.zh: 狂欢庆祝之后，他醒来时头痛欲裂，宿醉感持续了数小时。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 katzenjammer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: used of competition or cooperation between secondary schools

examples.en: Students from five local districts gathered to compete in the annual interschool debate championship.
examples.zh: 来自当地五个学区的学生齐聚一堂，参加年度校际辩论锦标赛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 interschool 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a quadric surface generated by rotating a hyperbola around its main axis

examples.en: The cooling tower was designed in the elegant shape of a revolving hyperboloid.
examples.zh: 这座冷却塔被设计成优雅的旋转双曲面形状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hyperboloid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a songbook containing a collection of hymns

examples.en: She opened the worn hymnbook to page forty and joined the morning choir.
examples.zh: 她翻开磨损的赞美诗集到第40页，加入了清晨合唱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hymnbook 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who builds houses as a business

examples.en: The local housebuilder promised to complete the new residential project before next winter.
examples.zh: 当地住宅建筑商承诺在明年冬天之前完成这个新住宅项目。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 housebuilder 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a French variety of green bean plant bearing light-colored beans

examples.en: She simmered a rich haricot stew with tender lamb and fresh garden vegetables.
examples.zh: 她用鲜嫩的羊肉和新鲜蔬菜炖制了一锅浓郁的肉糜菜豆汤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 haricot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 扭索状装饰, 连结环
lemmas.def_en: an architectural decoration formed by two intersecting wavy bands

examples.en: The border of the antique banknote featured an intricate guilloche to deter counterfeiters.
examples.zh: 这张古董纸币的边缘绘有精美的扭索状饰纹以防伪造。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guilloche 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large European dormouse

examples.en: The loir curled up tightly in its nest to sleep through the cold winter.
examples.zh: 睡鼠在巢穴里紧紧蜷缩成一团，安然度过寒冬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 loir 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a protective structure of stone or concrete; extends from shore into the water to prevent a beach from washing away

examples.en: The council constructed a new wooden groyne to prevent beach erosion along the coast.
examples.zh: 地方议会建造了一道新的木质丁坝，以防止海岸侵蚀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 groyne 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: surface layer of ground containing a mat of grass and grass roots

examples.en: Children ran freely across the vast greensward surrounding the historic countryside estate.
examples.zh: 孩子们在环绕着历史悠久的乡间庄园的广阔草坪上自由奔跑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greensward 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the number of the pregnancy that a woman is in

examples.en: The doctor carefully monitored the elderly gravida throughout the final weeks of pregnancy.
examples.zh: 在孕期的最后几周，医生对这位高龄孕妇进行了密切监护。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gravida 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a wage earner who is served with a garnishment

examples.en: The court ordered the bank to act as garnishee and withhold the debtor's funds.
examples.zh: 法院命令该银行作为第三债务人，扣留该债务人的资金。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 garnishee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 毛皮, 水垢, 板条
lemmas.def_en: a furlike coating of matter as on the tongue

examples.en: Workers installed wood furring strips along the masonry wall before attaching the drywall.
examples.zh: 工人们在安装石膏板之前，先沿砖墙安装了木质板条。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 furring 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who takes spoils or plunder (as in war)

examples.en: The notorious freebooter plundered merchant ships traveling along the unprotected coastal routes.
examples.zh: 臭名昭著的海盗洗劫了在无保护沿海航道上航行的商船。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 freebooter 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 扁长的, 扩展的, 延长的
lemmas.def_en: having the polar diameter greater than the equatorial diameter

examples.en: An American football has a distinct prolate shape compared to a round soccer ball.
examples.zh: 与圆形的足球相比，美式橄榄球具有明显的扁长椭圆形。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 prolate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an X-ray machine that combines an X-ray source and a fluorescent screen to enable direct observation

examples.en: The doctor used a fluoroscope to observe the patient's internal organs in real time.
examples.zh: 医生使用荧光镜实时观察病人的内部器官。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fluoroscope 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 语言表达方式, 语言风格
lemmas.def_en: a word or phrase that particular people use in particular situations

examples.en: Her archaic locution made it difficult for modern listeners to grasp her point.
examples.zh: 她古旧的语言风格使现代听众很难理解她的要点。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 locution 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 测定, 测量, 测定法
lemmas.def_en: the act or process of assigning numbers to phenomena according to a rule

examples.en: Basic mensuration skills are essential for carpenters when calculating the dimensions of wood.
examples.zh: 在计算木材尺寸时，基本的测量技能对木匠至关重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mensuration 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a normal ongoing process that dissolves fibrin and results in the removal of small blood clots

examples.en: The medication promotes fibrinolysis to dissolve dangerous blood clots in the patient's arteries.
examples.zh: 这种药物能促进纤维蛋白溶解，以消除患者动脉中的危险血栓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fibrinolysis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large wheel fitted with paddles and driven by an engine in order to propel a boat

examples.en: The old steamboat relied on a large paddlewheel to navigate up the muddy river.
examples.zh: 这艘老式轮船依靠一个大明轮在泥泞的河水中逆流而上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paddlewheel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (football) a kicker who makes a place kick for a goal

examples.en: Under immense pressure, the placekicker scored the winning field goal in the final seconds.
examples.zh: 在巨大的压力下，开球员在最后几秒命中了制胜的射门。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 placekicker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a liturgical chant of the Roman Catholic Church

examples.en: The monks filled the ancient stone chapel with the haunting melodies of medieval plainchant.
examples.zh: 僧侣们在中世纪单声圣歌空灵的旋律中填满了古老的石砌小教堂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 plainchant 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 岩石的, 岩石般的, 坚硬的
lemmas.def_en: (of bone especially the temporal bone) resembling stone in hardness

examples.en: The inner ear is encased within the petrous part of the temporal bone.
examples.zh: 内耳被包裹在颞骨坚硬如石的岩部内。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 petrous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having a valence of five

examples.en: Phosphorus can form a pentavalent compound by sharing five of its valence electrons.
examples.zh: 磷可以通过共享其五个价电子来形成五价化合物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pentavalent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various chiefly tropical American vines some bearing edible fruit

examples.en: A stunning passionflower bloomed in the garden, displaying its intricate and colorful petals.
examples.zh: 一朵惊艳的西番莲在花园中绽放，展现出复杂而绚丽的花瓣。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 passionflower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 到处是坑的, 崎岖不平的
lemmas.def_en: used of paved surfaces having holes or pits

examples.en: Driving along the potholed country road severely damaged the suspension of his new car.
examples.zh: 在坑洼不平的乡村道路上行驶严重损坏了他新车的悬挂系统。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 potholed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a portable balance consisting of a pivoted bar with arms of unequal length

examples.en: The vendor weighed the bag of fresh grain using a traditional brass steelyard.
examples.zh: 小贩用一把传统的黄铜杆秤给那袋新鲜粮食称重。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 steelyard 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: situated at the farthest possible point from a center

examples.en: The sentry stood watch at the outmost perimeter of the remote military base.
examples.zh: 哨兵在这个偏远军事基地的最外围警戒线上站岗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 outmost 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: after death the soul begins a new cycle of existence in another human body

examples.en: Certain ancient philosophies teach the doctrine of metempsychosis, the transmigration of the soul.
examples.zh: 某些古代哲学传授灵魂转生与轮回的学说。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 metempsychosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of medicine dealing with the anatomy and development and diseases of the teeth

examples.en: Forensic odontology helped investigators identify the victim using historical dental records.
examples.zh: 法医牙科学利用过往的牙科记录帮助调查人员确认了受害者身份。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 odontology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小瘤, 小节, (玉蜀黍)发育不良的穗
lemmas.def_en: a small nub (especially an undeveloped fruit or ear of corn)

examples.en: Due to the severe drought, the cornfield yielded only small, dry nubbins.
examples.zh: 由于严重干旱，玉米田里只结出了一些干瘪细小的发育不良果穗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nubbin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having nine units or components

examples.en: The company reported a ninefold increase in profits following their latest overseas expansion.
examples.zh: 公司在最近一次海外扩张后报告了九倍的利润增长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ninefold 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 美国南部夜间骑马为非作歹的人, 三K党员
lemmas.def_en: member of a secret mounted band in United States South after the American Civil War; committed acts of intimidation and revenge

examples.en: Local communities lived in fear as a notorious nightrider targeted farmers after dark.
examples.zh: 当地社区生活在恐惧中，因为一个臭名昭著的夜行暴徒总在天黑后针对农民下手。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 nightrider 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in front of the heart; involving the precordium

examples.en: The patient complained of sharp precordial pain spreading toward his left arm.
examples.zh: 患者主诉心前区有剧烈疼痛，并向左臂扩散。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 precordial 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: syphilis of the central nervous system

examples.en: Without early antibiotic treatment, the chronic bacterial infection may eventually lead to neurosyphilis.
examples.zh: 如果不及早进行抗生素治疗，这种慢性细菌感染最终可能导致神经梅毒。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 neurosyphilis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 超然派, 骑墙派, 大人物, 头子, 脱党者, 独立分子
lemmas.def_en: someone who bolted from the Republican Party during the U.S. presidential election of 1884

examples.en: Refusing to endorse either party candidate, he acted as a true political mugwump.
examples.zh: 他拒绝支持任何一方的政党候选人，表现得像一个真正的政治超然派。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mugwump 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 抗火的, 耐火的, 防火的
lemmas.def_en: resistant to catching fire

examples.en: The firefighters wore flameproof suits to protect themselves from intense heat.
examples.zh: 消防员穿上防火服以抵御高温。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flameproof 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 胡说, 胡扯, 欺骗, 荒唐
lemmas.def_en: a swindle in which you cheat at gambling or persuade a person to buy worthless property

examples.en: Don't fall for his clever financial flimflam; he is a swindler.
examples.zh: 别被他狡猾的财务骗局蒙蔽，他是个骗子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 flimflam 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: bushy aromatic European perennial herb having clusters of buttonlike white-rayed flower heads; valued traditionally for medicinal uses; sometimes placed in genus Chrysanthemum

examples.en: Grandmother brewed feverfew tea to help relieve her chronic migraine pain.
examples.zh: 祖母冲泡小白菊茶以缓解她的慢性偏头痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 feverfew 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of the deeper and thicker fascia that attach muscles to bones; resemble flattened tendons

examples.en: The surgeon carefully repaired the torn abdominal aponeurosis during the procedure.
examples.zh: 外科医生在手术中仔细修复了破裂的腹部腱膜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 aponeurosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: meter to measure electrostatic voltage differences; draws no current from the source

examples.en: The physicist used a sensitive electrometer to detect the faint electrical charge.
examples.zh: 物理学家使用灵敏的静电计来探测微弱的电荷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 electrometer 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: expressive of or exciting sexual love or romance

examples.en: He poured his intense passion into an amatory poem for his beloved.
examples.zh: 他将满腔热忱倾注于写给心上人的情诗中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amatory 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 吸附物; 被吸附物
lemmas.def_en: capable of being adsorbed or accumulated on a surface of a solid

examples.en: The activated carbon efficiently trapped the gas adsorbate onto its porous surface.
examples.zh: 活性炭有效地将气体吸附物截留在其多孔表面上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 adsorbate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: producing pus

examples.en: The deep wound became infected with pyogenic bacteria and quickly formed pus.
examples.zh: 伤口深处感染了化脓性细菌，迅速形成了脓液。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pyogenic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: made of dried flower heads of pyrethrum plants

examples.en: Organic gardeners often spray natural pyrethrum to eliminate unwanted pests safely.
examples.zh: 有机园艺师经常喷洒天然除虫菊酯来安全清除害虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pyrethrum 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: mechanical device consisting of a toothed wheel or rack engaged with a pawl that permits it to move in only one direction

examples.en: The mechanic tightened the stubborn bolt using an adjustable rachet wrench.
examples.zh: 机械师用可调节棘轮扳手拧紧了那个顽固的螺栓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rachet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: in a manner that is reproducible

examples.en: The lab team was able to reproducibly synthesize the compound under identical conditions.
examples.zh: 实验室团队能够在相同条件下可重复地合成该化合物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reproducibly 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 斜方六面体的, 菱形的
lemmas.def_en: having threefold symmetry

examples.en: The mineral sample exhibited a distinct rhombohedral crystal structure under the microscope.
examples.zh: 该矿物样品在显微镜下呈现出明显的菱形晶体结构。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 rhombohedral 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a small constellation in the northern hemisphere between Cygnus and Aquila and crossed by the Milky Way

examples.en: On clear autumn nights, you can spot the faint constellation Sagitta overhead.
examples.zh: 在晴朗的秋夜，你可以在头顶辨认出微弱的天箭座。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sagitta 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a maker of sails

examples.en: The experienced sailmaker mended the torn canvas before the ship set sail.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的制帆工在船启航前修补好了破损的帆布。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sailmaker 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (Yiddish) excessive sentimentality in art or music

examples.en: The romantic movie was criticized for relying on excessive melodrama and schmalz.
examples.zh: 这部浪漫电影因过度依赖耸人听闻的情节和感伤滥情而受批评。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schmalz 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a scholar who writes explanatory notes on an author (especially an ancient commentator on a classical author)

examples.en: The medieval scholiast added detailed explanatory notes in the manuscript's wide margins.
examples.zh: 中世纪的评注者在手稿的宽空白处添加了详细的注释。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scholiast 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (philosophy) a philosophical theory of the functions of signs and symbols

examples.en: His groundbreaking lecture explored medical semiology and the interpretation of clinical signs.
examples.zh: 他开创性的讲座探讨了医学症状学以及临床体征的解读。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semiology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of a membrane) selectively permeable

examples.en: Water enters the root cells through a semipermeable membrane via natural osmosis.
examples.zh: 水通过自然渗透穿过半透膜进入植物根细胞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semipermeable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 20th century music that uses a definite order of notes as a thematic basis for a musical composition

examples.en: The modern composer abandoned traditional tonal harmony in favor of strict serialism.
examples.zh: 这位现代作曲家放弃了传统调性，转向严格的序列主义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 serialism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: European scaleless blenny

examples.en: We found a small shanny hiding under a rock in the tidal pool.
examples.zh: 我们发现一条小线鳚躲在潮汐池的一块石头下。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shanny 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to the sigmoid flexure in the large intestine

examples.en: The bacterial colony grew following a typical sigmoidal curve over forty-eight hours.
examples.zh: 细菌菌落的生长在48小时内呈现出经典的S型曲线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sigmoidal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 和蔼可亲地, 善于应酬地
lemmas.def_en: in a gregarious manner

examples.en: She chatted sociably with every guest who arrived at the evening party.
examples.zh: 她和善地与每一位到达晚会的客人谈天说地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sociably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: someone who does not believe in the social or economic or political equality of men and women

examples.en: The politician was fiercely criticized for his outspoken and backward antifeminist views.
examples.zh: 这位政客因其公然发表落后的反女权主义观点而受到猛烈批评。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 antifeminist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the time and process of budding and unfolding of blossoms

examples.en: The cherry blossoms reached full anthesis, covering the entire park in pink.
examples.zh: 樱花迎来了盛花期，让整个公园染上了一片粉红。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anthesis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the planning that is disrupted when someone `upsets the applecart'

examples.en: Be careful not to upset the applecart just before the project deadline.
examples.zh: 在项目截止前，千万小心别把全盘计划打乱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 applecart 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having lost teeth

examples.en: The clinic offers specialized dental implants designed specifically for edentulous elderly patients.
examples.zh: 该诊所为缺齿的老年患者提供专门设计的牙种植体。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 edentulous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the branch of philology that is devoted to the study of dialects

examples.en: Her groundbreaking research in dialectology revealed subtle linguistic shifts across the valley.
examples.zh: 她在方言学方面的开创性研究揭示了整个山谷细微的语言演变。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dialectology 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: medium-sized greyish-black whale of the northern Pacific

examples.en: Divers were thrilled to spot a giant devilfish gliding above the reef.
examples.zh: 潜水员们非常兴奋地看到一只巨大的蝠鲼滑过暗礁。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 devilfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: more or less flat-topped cluster of flowers in which the central or terminal flower opens first

examples.en: The botanist carefully examined the delicate cyme blooming at the stem apex.
examples.zh: 植物学家仔细检查了茎顶端盛开的娇嫩聚伞花序。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cyme 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various plants of the genus Crotalaria having inflated pods within which the seeds rattle; used for pasture and green-manure crops

examples.en: Farmers frequently plant crotalaria as a cover crop to enrich poor soil.
examples.zh: 农民经常种植猪屎豆作为覆盖作物，以改善贫瘠的土壤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crotalaria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to or characteristic of an autobiographer

examples.en: Her latest novel contains many autobiographic elements from her turbulent teenage years.
examples.zh: 她的最新小说包含了许多关于她动荡青少年时期的自传体元素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autobiographic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: naughtily or annoyingly playful

examples.en: A puckish grin spread across his face before he revealed the prank.
examples.zh: 在揭穿这个恶作剧之前，他脸上浮现出一抹顽皮的坏笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 puckish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 细圆齿状的, 小圆齿状的
lemmas.def_en: having a margin with small rounded teeth

examples.en: The unique plant species is easily recognized by its distinctive crenulated leaves.
examples.zh: 这种独特的植物很容易通过其标志性的小圆齿状叶片被辨认出来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crenulated 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of three isomeric hydrocarbons C4H8; all used in making synthetic rubbers

examples.en: The chemical plant uses butene as an essential raw material in polymer production.
examples.zh: 这家化工厂使用丁烯作为聚合物生产的重要原材料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 butene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: emotionally charged terms used to refer to extreme radicals or revolutionaries

examples.en: He turned quite bolshie whenever the manager asked him to work overtime.
examples.zh: 每当经理要求他加班时，他就会变得非常不合作。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bolshie 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a broom made of twigs tied together on a long handle

examples.en: The old cottage porch was neatly swept with a traditional heather besom.
examples.zh: 老屋的门廊被一把传统的石楠长扫帚打扫得干干净净。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 besom 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a wide (ornamented) belt worn over the right shoulder to support a sword or bugle by the left hip

examples.en: The royal knight wore an ornate leather baldric supporting his heavy ceremonial sword.
examples.zh: 这位皇家骑士佩戴着一条华丽的皮质肩带，用来挂载沉重的礼仪剑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baldric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: producing a radiograph by means of the radiation emitted from the specimen being photographed

examples.en: The researchers used autoradiography to track the distribution of the radiolabeled drug precisely.
examples.zh: 研究人员利用自体放射照相术精确追踪了放射性标记药物的分布情况。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autoradiography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 皮契茄(南美一种茄科植物,其嫩叶用于膀胱炎)
lemmas.def_en: Peruvian shrub with small pink to lavender tubular flowers; leaves yield a tonic and diuretic

examples.en: Traditional healers in the Andes often recommend pichi tea for urinary infections.
examples.zh: 安第斯山脉的传统草医常推荐饮用皮契茄茶来治疗尿路感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pichi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various plants of the genus Vernonia of tropical and warm regions of especially North America that take their name from their loose heads of purple to rose flowers that quickly take on a rusty hue

examples.en: The brilliant purple flowers of vernonia brightened the late summer meadow landscape.
examples.zh: 斑鸠菊鲜艳的紫色花朵点亮了夏末草地的景致。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vernonia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (North American informal) To vomit.

examples.en: The rough seas made several passengers feel sick enough to upchuck overboard.
examples.zh: 汹涌的风浪让几名乘客感到非常恶心，以至于对着舷外呕吐。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 upchuck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: undergarment worn under a skirt

examples.en: She adjusted the stiff underskirt to give her ball gown extra dramatic volume.
examples.zh: 她整理了一下硬衬裙，让她的舞会礼服显得更加蓬松夸张。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 underskirt 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 三叶的, 具三叶的, 三叶形饰的
lemmas.def_en: (of a leaf shape) having three leaflets

examples.en: Children happily searched the lawn for a rare four-leaf variation of the trifoliate clover.
examples.zh: 孩子们高兴地在草坪上寻找罕见的三叶草四叶变异株。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 trifoliate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To coat a metal object with a thin layer of silver using electroplating.

examples.en: The artisan decided to silverplate the brass teapot to enhance its final shine.
examples.zh: 工匠决定在黄铜茶壶上镀银，以提升其最终的光泽。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 silverplate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an inherited form of anemia caused by faulty synthesis of hemoglobin

examples.en: Regular blood transfusions are essential for patients suffering from severe forms of thalassaemia.
examples.zh: 定期输血对于重型地中海贫血患者来说至关重要。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thalassaemia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 微粒照片, 小粒迷幻药
lemmas.def_en: photograph reduced to the size of a dot (usually for purposes of security)

examples.en: The spy hid the top-secret formula inside a microdot disguised as a period.
examples.zh: 间谍将绝密配方藏在伪装成句号的微粒照片中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 microdot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （英国议会中的）前座议员（政府大臣或反对党领袖）
lemmas.def_en: a member of the House of Commons who is a minister in the government or who holds an official position in an opposition party

examples.en: A prominent frontbencher rose to challenge the prime minister's latest economic policy.
examples.zh: 一位杰出的前座议员起身质疑首相最新的经济政策。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 frontbencher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Gloriosa of tropical Africa and Asia; a perennial herb climbing by means of tendrils at leaf tips having showy yellow to red or purple flowers; all parts are poisonous

examples.en: The vintage umbrella was made of fine gloriosa that kept out the rain.
examples.zh: 这把老式雨伞由优质伞绸制成，非常防雨。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gloriosa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 奇怪相貌的木偶, 怪物, 脸形奇丑的人
lemmas.def_en: a grotesque black doll

examples.en: She found an old cloth golliwog tucked away in the dusty attic trunk.
examples.zh: 她在布满灰尘的阁楼箱子深处发现了一个旧黑人玩偶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 golliwog 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an outer garment consisting of a large piece of white cloth; worn by men and women in northern Africa

examples.en: The traveler wore a traditional white haik to protect against the desert sun.
examples.zh: 旅行者穿着传统的白色长袍以抵御沙漠的烈日。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 haik 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: swelling from excessive accumulation of watery fluid in cells, tissues, or serous cavities

examples.en: The ultrasound examination revealed fetal hydrops, prompting doctors to intervene immediately.
examples.zh: 超声检查发现了胎儿积水，医生立即进行了干预。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hydrops 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a lack of efficacy

examples.en: The clinical trial was halted early due to the obvious inefficacy of the drug.
examples.zh: 由于该药物疗效明显不足，临床试验被提前终止。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inefficacy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不能根除的, 根深蒂固的
lemmas.def_en: not able to be destroyed or rooted out

examples.en: Childhood memories left an ineradicable mark on his entire artistic career.
examples.zh: 童年记忆在他整个艺术生涯中留下了不可磨灭的印记。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ineradicable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the second pillar of Islam is prayer; a prescribed liturgy performed five times a day (preferably in a mosque) and oriented toward Mecca

examples.en: Devout Muslims pause their daily activities five times a day to perform salaah.
examples.zh: 虔诚的穆斯林每天暂停日常活动五次来进行礼拜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 salaah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not transparent to X-rays or other forms of radiation

examples.en: The surgeon injected a radiopaque dye to make the blood vessels clearly visible.
examples.zh: 外科医生注射了不透射线的造影剂，使血管清晰可见。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 radiopaque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: an expert who is highly skilled in obscure or difficult or esoteric matters

examples.en: The learned kabbalist spent years interpreting the esoteric meanings behind ancient texts.
examples.zh: 这位饱学的卡巴拉学者多年来一直致力于解释古代文献背后的深奥含义。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kabbalist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of various plants of the genus Centaurea having purple thistlelike flowers

examples.en: Purple knapweed blossomed along the meadow paths, attracting dozens of wild bees.
examples.zh: 紫色的矢车菊在草地小径旁盛开，引来了数十只野蜂。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 knapweed 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not subject to leaks

examples.en: Make sure you pack the soup in a certified leakproof container for travel.
examples.zh: 出行时一定要把汤装在经认证防漏的容器里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 leakproof 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 停止, 中止, 放松
lemmas.def_en: a pause during which things are calm or activities are diminished

examples.en: The heavy rain continued throughout the night without any sign of a letup.
examples.zh: 大雨持续了一整夜，丝毫没有停歇的迹象。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 letup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very hard brown to brownish-red heartwood of a logwood tree; used in preparing a purplish red dye

examples.en: Dyers historically used logwood extract to produce deep black and rich purple shades.
examples.zh: 历史上染匠们使用洋苏木提取物来调制深黑与浓紫色调。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 logwood 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rotary duplicator that uses a stencil through which ink is pressed (trade mark Roneo)

examples.en: The teacher used to mimeo weekly quizzes for the entire class every Monday.
examples.zh: 老师过去每周一都会为全班油印每周测验卷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mimeo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 使变小, 使缩小, 使降低
lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (computing / formal) To remove unnecessary spaces and characters from source code to reduce file size, or make smaller.

examples.en: Developers always minify JavaScript files to reduce page loading times significantly.
examples.zh: 开发人员总是压缩 JavaScript 文件，以显著缩短页面加载时间。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 minify 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [医] 共生生物, 共栖生物
lemmas.def_en: mutually dependent

examples.en: Bees and flowers have a mutualist relationship that benefits both participating species.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂和花朵之间存在互利共生关系，使双方物种均获益。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mutualist 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] To place excessive emphasis on a point, or put too much mechanical or mental strain on something.

examples.en: Running heavy background processes can easily overstress the server's central processor.
examples.zh: 运行繁重的后台进程很容易使服务器的中央处理器过载。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overstress 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: primitive fish of the Mississippi valley having a long paddle-shaped snout

examples.en: The American paddlefish uses its long, sensitive snout to detect plankton swarms.
examples.zh: 美洲匙吻鲟利用其敏感的长吻来探测浮游生物群。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paddlefish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 对硫磷; 硝苯硫磷酯; E-605; 1605
lemmas.def_en: a colorless and odorless toxic oil used as an insecticide

examples.en: Many countries banned parathion because its extreme toxicity endangered farm workers.
examples.zh: 由于对硫磷的高毒性危及农场工人，许多国家已禁止使用它。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parathion 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有花梗的, 有梗的, 有肉茎的
lemmas.def_en: having or growing on or from a peduncle or stalk

examples.en: The English oak is widely recognized by its distinctive pedunculate acorns.
examples.zh: 英国栎因其独特的长梗橡子而广为人知。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pedunculate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 可说服的, 可使相信的
lemmas.def_en: being susceptible to persuasion

examples.en: Although she seemed stubborn at first, she proved persuadable once presented with clear evidence.
examples.zh: 尽管她起初显得很固执，但在看到确凿证据后还是被说服了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 persuadable 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: relish of chopped pickled cucumbers and green peppers and onion

examples.en: He spread a spoonful of spicy piccalilli over his cold roast beef sandwich.
examples.zh: 他把一勺酸辣泡菜涂在冷烤牛肉三明治上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 piccalilli 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small European brown bat

examples.en: At dusk, a tiny pipistrelle fluttered past the old barn in search of insects.
examples.zh: 黄昏时分，一只小小的伏翼飞过旧谷仓去捕食昆虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pipistrelle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: renal disorder characterized by the production of large volumes of pale dilute urine; often associated with diabetes

examples.en: Frequent thirst and polyuria are among the most common early symptoms of untreated diabetes.
examples.zh: 口渴和多尿是未治疗糖尿病最常见的早期症状。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 polyuria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: arboreal fruit-eating mammal of tropical America with a long prehensile tail

examples.en: The nocturnal potto moved slowly through the dense canopy, gripping branches with remarkable strength.
examples.zh: 这只夜行树熊猴在茂密的树冠中缓慢穿行，有力地抓紧树枝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 potto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 加压的, 增高血压的, 使机能亢进的
lemmas.def_en: increasing (or tending to increase) blood pressure

examples.en: The doctor administered a pressor drug to restore the patient's dangerously low blood pressure.
examples.zh: 医生使用了一种升压药，以恢复该患者极低的血压。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pressor 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 总状花序的, 总状排列的, 葡萄状的
lemmas.def_en: having stalked flowers along an elongated stem that continue to open in succession from below as the stem continues to grow

examples.en: The plant is easily recognized by its racemose inflorescence bearing delicate purple flowers.
examples.zh: 这种植物很容易辨认，其总状花序上开着娇嫩的紫花。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 racemose 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 裙环, (用裙环撑开的)裙环裙
lemmas.def_en: a hoop worn beneath a skirt to extend it horizontally; worn by European women in the 16th and 17th centuries

examples.en: The Elizabethan noblewoman wore an elaborate farthingale beneath her heavy embroidered silk gown.
examples.zh: 这位伊丽莎白时代的贵妇在厚重的刺绣丝绸礼服下穿了精致的裙环。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 farthingale 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无决断的, 优柔寡断的, 踌躇不定的
lemmas.def_en: uncertain how to act or proceed

examples.en: He stood irresolute at the crossroads, unable to decide which path to take.
examples.zh: 他优柔寡断地站在十字路口，无法决定该走哪条路。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 irresolute 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a framework for holding wood that is being sawed

examples.en: The carpenter laid the heavy timber across a wooden sawhorse before cutting it.
examples.zh: 木匠在切割前把厚木料横架在一个木制锯木架上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 sawhorse 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any customary and rightful perquisite appropriate to your station in life

examples.en: The grand estate was granted to the duke's younger son as a lifelong appanage.
examples.zh: 这处宏伟的庄园被赐予公爵的次子，作为终身封禄。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 appanage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of three isomeric hydrocarbons C4H8; all used in making synthetic rubbers

examples.en: The chemical plant uses butylene as a key raw material for manufacturing synthetic rubber.
examples.zh: 该化工厂利用丁烯作为制造合成橡胶的关键原料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 butylene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: fortification consisting of a low wall

examples.en: The defenders quickly piled logs and earth to construct a makeshift defensive breastwork.
examples.zh: 防守队员迅速堆起圆木和泥土，搭建了一个简易的矮胸墙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 breastwork 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: of or relating to a bolometer

examples.en: Astronomers used a sensitive bolometric detector to measure the faint infrared radiation of stars.
examples.zh: 天文学家使用高灵敏度的测辐射热探测器来测量微弱的恒星红外辐射。

lemmas.def_en: an instrument that measures heat radiation; extremely sensitive

examples.en: The sensitive bolometer detected faint changes in infrared radiation across the distant galaxy.
examples.zh: 灵敏的辐射热测定器探测到了遥远星系中微弱的红外辐射变化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bolometric 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 玩世不恭之作风或思想
lemmas.def_en: conduct characteristic of a bohemian

examples.en: Drawn to artistic freedom, she embraced the lifestyle of bohemianism in early twentieth-century Paris.
examples.zh: 受到艺术自由的吸引，她在二十世纪初的巴黎投身于放荡不羁的生活方式。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bohemianism 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: under the level of the ground

examples.en: Most of the plant's biomass was concentrated in its dense belowground root system.
examples.zh: 该植物的大部分生物量都集中在其密集的地下根系中。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 belowground 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (archaic) To anoint someone with consecrated oil, especially as part of last rites before death.

examples.en: The village priest arrived at midnight to anele the dying soldier before his passing.
examples.zh: 乡村牧师在午夜赶来，为临终的士兵行涂油礼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 anele 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [生化]缩胆囊素,缩胆囊肽, 肠促胰酶肽
lemmas.def_en: a gastrointestinal hormone that stimulates the secretion of pancreatic enzymes and the contraction and emptying of the gall bladder; its release is stimulated by the presence of fatty acids and amino acids in the small intestine

examples.en: The presence of dietary fat triggers the small intestine to release the hormone cholecystokinin.
examples.zh: 饮食中脂肪的存在会促使小肠释放缩胆囊素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cholecystokinin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 重还, 归还,承受转归领主的土地
lemmas.def_en: a reversion to the state (as the ultimate owner of property) in the absence of legal heirs

examples.en: Since the owner died without heirs or a will, the property reverted through escheat.
examples.zh: 由于房主去世时既无继承人也未立遗嘱，该地产被收归公有。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 escheat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: partial or total loss of sight without pathology of the eye; caused by disease of optic nerve or retina or brain

examples.en: The sudden onset of complete amaurosis left the patient unable to perceive any light.
examples.zh: 突发的完全性黑朦使患者完全无法感知任何光线。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amaurosis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: narrow and long and pointed; as pine leaves

examples.en: Under the microscope, the mineral crystals displayed a sharp, beautifully formed acicular structure.
examples.zh: 在显微镜下，这些矿物晶体呈现出锋利而结构优美的针状外形。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 acicular 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: resembling a spring or the action of a spring

examples.en: A sudden springlike warmth thawed the frozen ground and brought birds into the garden.
examples.zh: 一股骤然降临的春日般暖意融化了冻土，引得鸟儿飞入花园。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 springlike 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: faucet consisting of a rotating device for regulating flow of a liquid

examples.en: Turn the brass stopcock clockwise to completely shut off the laboratory gas supply.
examples.zh: 顺时针旋转黄铜开关以彻底切断实验室的燃气供应。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 stopcock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flat semisweet cookie or biscuit usually served with tea

examples.en: She served toasted teacakes with butter alongside our afternoon Earl Grey tea.
examples.zh: 她在我们的下午格雷伯爵茶旁配上了涂有黄油的烤茶点饼干。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 teacake 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a fat-soluble vitamin that prevents rickets

examples.en: The doctor recommended a daily dose of cholecalciferol to treat his vitamin deficiency.
examples.zh: 医生建议他每天服用维生素D3以治疗其维生素缺乏症。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cholecalciferol 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (pregnancy) extraction by centesis of amniotic fluid from a pregnant woman (after the 15th week of pregnancy) to aid in the diagnosis of fetal abnormalities

examples.en: The doctor advised her to undergo an amnio to test for genetic abnormalities.
examples.zh: 医生建议她做羊膜穿刺术以检测遗传异常。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 amnio 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 天赋的, 先天的, 同族的
lemmas.def_en: of similar parts or organs; closely joined or united

examples.en: The philosopher argued that humans possess a connate sense of morality from birth.
examples.zh: 这位哲学家认为人类生来就具有先天的道德感。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 connate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a gap or vacant space between two teeth

examples.en: The model embraced the distinctive diastema between her upper front teeth with confidence.
examples.zh: 这位模特自信地展现了她上门牙之间那独特的间隙。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diastema 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 如小精灵的, 好恶作剧的, 小妖精的
lemmas.def_en: usually good-naturedly mischievous

examples.en: The mischievous boy looked at his mother with an elfish grin on his face.
examples.zh: 那个淘气的男孩脸上带着顽皮狡黠的笑容看着他的母亲。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 elfish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a hired hand who tends cattle and performs other duties on horseback

examples.en: The tired cowpoke guided the herd of cattle across the river before sunset.
examples.zh: 疲惫的牛仔在日落前引导着牛群穿过了河流。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cowpoke 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tapeworms whose larvae are parasitic in humans and domestic animals

examples.en: The medical research paper described a rare parasitic infection caused by the echinococcus tapeworm.
examples.zh: 这篇医学研究论文描述了一种由棘球绦虫引起的罕见寄生虫感染。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 echinococcus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: impaired ability to learn to write

examples.en: The student received special accommodations during his exams due to his severe dysgraphia.
examples.zh: 由于严重的书写困难，该学生在考试期间获得了特殊照顾。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dysgraphia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a nail with a large head; formerly used to decorate doors

examples.en: The ancient car engine in the yard was finally as dead as a doornail.
examples.zh: 院子里那台老旧的汽车发动机终于彻底坏透报废了。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 doornail 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: African tree with edible yellow fruit resembling mangos; valued for its oil-rich seed and hardy green wood that resists termites

examples.en: The villagers harvested the rich nuts of the dika tree to make traditional paste.
examples.zh: 村民们采收了野芒果树富含油脂的坚果来制作传统酱料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dika 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 超过停泊日期, 滞留费
lemmas.def_en: a charge required as compensation for the delay of a ship or freight car or other cargo beyond its scheduled time of departure

examples.en: The shipping company had to pay hefty demurrage because the cargo was delayed at port.
examples.zh: 由于货物在港口延误，航运公司不得不支付高额的滞期费。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 demurrage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: combustion that propagates through a gas or along the surface of an explosive at a rapid rate driven by the transfer of heat

examples.en: The accidental gas leak caused a sudden deflagration that rattled the windows nearby.
examples.zh: 意外的燃气泄漏引发了突然爆燃，震得附近的窗户咔咔作响。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deflagration 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the ball-and-socket joint between the head of the femur and the acetabulum

examples.en: The orthopedic specialist examined the patient's damaged coxa to evaluate the need for surgery.
examples.zh: 骨科专家检查了患者受损的髋关节，以评估是否需要手术。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 coxa 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: having a taste that is a mixture of bitterness and sweetness

examples.en: Melt the semisweet chocolate chips over low heat before folding them into the batter.
examples.zh: 在将半甜巧克力片拌入面糊之前，先用小火将其融化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 semisweet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: taking a small amount into the mouth to test its quality

examples.en: We booked an evening degustation featuring seven small courses paired with local wines.
examples.zh: 我们预订了一场晚间品鉴宴，包含了七道配有当地美酒的小菜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 degustation 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 了不起的, 极好的, 浮华的
lemmas.def_en: having great beauty and splendor

examples.en: The royal palace ballroom was decorated with splendiferous chandeliers and velvet drapes throughout.
examples.zh: 皇宫宴会厅通体装饰着华丽非凡的水晶吊灯和天鹅绒窗帘。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 splendiferous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a long noosed rope used to catch animals

examples.en: The skilled cowboy coiled his leather reata before preparing to rope the stray calf.
examples.zh: 熟练的牛仔在准备套住走失的小牛前卷好了他的皮套索。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 reata 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 愿死者灵魂安息的祈祷
lemmas.def_en: a prayer for the repose of the soul of a dead person

examples.en: The priest offered a solemn requiescat for the repose of the departed hero's soul.
examples.zh: 神父为逝去英雄的灵魂安息献上了庄严的祈祷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 requiescat 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 回旋歌, 圆圈舞, 小鸟的鸣啭
lemmas.def_en: a song in which a line or phrase is repeated as the refrain

examples.en: The merry villagers joined hands and danced in circles while singing a lively roundelay.
examples.zh: 欢快的村民们手拉着手围成圈跳舞，同时唱着轻快的回旋歌。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 roundelay 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a friend who attends the same school

examples.en: I ran into an old schoolfriend while shopping at the grocery store yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 昨天下午在杂货店买东西时，我碰巧遇到了一位老同学。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schoolfriend 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman schoolteacher (especially one regarded as strict)

examples.en: The strict schoolmarm scolded the noisy children and demanded absolute silence in class.
examples.zh: 严厉的女教师训斥了喧闹的孩子们，并要求课堂上绝对安静。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 schoolmarm 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 切断, 分离, 分裂
lemmas.def_en: the act of dividing by cutting or splitting

examples.en: A sudden scission within the party led to the formation of a rival faction.
examples.zh: 党内突然的分裂导致了一个敌对派系的形成。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 scission 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [网络] 作证言；夏哈达；作证词
lemmas.def_en: the first pillar of Islam is an affirmation of faith

examples.en: Reciting the Shahadah is considered the first of the five pillars in Islam.
examples.zh: 诵读作证词被视为伊斯兰教五大支柱之首。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 shahadah 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: singing using solfa syllables to denote the notes of the scale of C major

examples.en: The choir warmed up by practicing rapid solfeggio scales together.
examples.zh: 唱诗班通过一起练习快速唱名音阶来开嗓。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 solfeggio 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a game with two players who use rackets to strike a ball that is tethered to the top of a pole; the object is to wrap the string around the pole

examples.en: Children rushed to the playground to play tetherball during the lunch recess.
examples.zh: 午休时，孩子们冲向操场去打绳球。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tetherball 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a heading of a subdivision of a text

examples.en: Add a concise subhead under the main title to clarify the article's topic.
examples.zh: 在主标题下方添加一个简明的小标题以阐明文章主题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 subhead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 锡矿工, 洋铁匠, 罐头商
lemmas.def_en: someone who makes or repairs tinware

examples.en: The local tinner skillfully repaired the leaking tin buckets and kitchenware.
examples.zh: 当地的洋铁匠熟练地修好了漏水的铁桶和厨具。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tinner 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 总额计算器,赛马赌金计算器
lemmas.def_en: computer that registers bets and divides the total amount bet among those who won

examples.en: Bettors gathered around the digital totalisator to check the latest racing odds.
examples.zh: 赌客们聚集在数字赛马赌金计算器周围查看最新赔率。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 totalisator 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: migratory shorebirds of the plover family that turn over stones in searching for food

examples.en: A small ruddy turnstone flipped pebbles along the shore looking for food.
examples.zh: 一只小小的翻石鹬在岸边翻开鹅卵石寻找食物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 turnstone 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 未花费的,未用光的, 未耗尽的
lemmas.def_en: (of financial resources) not spent

examples.en: Any unexpended funds from this grant must be returned by the year's end.
examples.zh: 该笔拨款中任何未用尽的资金必须在年底前退还。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unexpended 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: dilatation of the veins associated with the spermatic cord in the testes

examples.en: The doctor confirmed that a mild varicocele was the cause of his discomfort.
examples.zh: 医生证实轻度精索静脉曲张是他感到不适的原因。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 varicocele 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the narrow central part of the cerebellum between the two hemispheres

examples.en: Damage to the cerebellar vermis can result in severe balance and posture issues.
examples.zh: 小脑蚓体受损可能导致严重的平衡和姿势问题。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vermis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 狐狸的, 狐狸似的, 诡计多端的
lemmas.def_en: resembling or characteristic of a fox

examples.en: He smiled with a vulpine cunning that made everyone in the room uneasy.
examples.zh: 他带着狡黠诡诈的微笑，让房间里的每个人都感到不安。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vulpine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 干皮病, 皮肤干燥病
lemmas.def_en: a mild form of ichthyosis characterized by abnormal dryness and roughness of the skin

examples.en: Patients suffering from severe xeroderma require rich moisturizers to soothe their skin.
examples.zh: 患有严重干皮病的患者需要滋润的保湿剂来舒缓皮肤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 xeroderma 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a rise in the temperature of the body; frequently a symptom of infection

examples.en: The patient was admitted to the hospital with acute pyrexia and chills.
examples.zh: 该患者因急性发热和发冷被送入医院治疗。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pyrexia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: not returned in kind

examples.en: She endured the quiet ache of unreciprocated love for several years.
examples.zh: 她忍受了数年得不到回报的单恋带来的无声痛苦。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 unreciprocated 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无线电报机, 无线电报术
lemmas.def_en: telegraphy that uses transmission by radio rather than by wire

examples.en: The ship sent an urgent distress call over the radiotelegraph during the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中，轮船通过无线电报机发出了紧急求救信号。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 radiotelegraph 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: flesh of a medium-sized young chicken suitable for frying

examples.en: The young pullet began laying small brown eggs early this spring.
examples.zh: 那只小母鸡在今年早春开始产下小棕壳蛋。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pullet 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: exhibiting native good judgment

examples.en: Her commonsensical approach helped resolve the dispute quickly and peacefully.
examples.zh: 她合乎常理的处理方式帮助迅速且和平地解决了争端。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 commonsensical 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: (糖果或点心面上的)巧克力层
lemmas.def_en: chocolate that contains at least 32 percent cocoa butter

examples.en: The pastry chef melted high-grade couverture chocolate to coat the delicate truffles.
examples.zh: 糕点师融化了高档巧克力层原料来包裹精致的松露巧克力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 couverture 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a prehistoric megalithic tomb typically having two large upright stones and a capstone

examples.en: Tourists visited the ancient cromlech standing quietly on the windswept moor.
examples.zh: 游客们参观了静静矗立在迎风荒原上的古代环状列石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cromlech 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 小标题, 子题, 十字头
lemmas.def_en: a heading of a subsection printed within the body of the text

examples.en: Break up long paragraphs by inserting a descriptive crosshead every few hundred words.
examples.zh: 每隔几百字插入一个描述性小标题以打碎长段落。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 crosshead 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the use of extreme cold (usually liquid nitrogen) to destroy unwanted tissue (warts or cataracts or skin cancers)

examples.en: The dermatologist used cryosurgery to safely freeze and remove the abnormal skin cells.
examples.zh: 皮肤科医生使用冷冻手术安全地冷冻并去除了异常皮肤细胞。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cryosurgery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: swift agile wolf-sized bipedal dinosaur having a large curved claw on each hind foot; of the Cretaceous

examples.en: The agile Deinonychus used its large, curved claws to ambush prey effectively.
examples.zh: 敏捷的恐爪龙利用其巨大弯曲的爪子有效地伏击猎物。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 deinonychus 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a method of physical therapy that involves generating local heat in body tissues by high-frequency electromagnetic currents

examples.en: The physical therapist applied diathermy to relieve deep muscle stiffness in his back.
examples.zh: 物理治疗师采用透热疗法来缓解他背部的深层肌肉僵硬。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 diathermy 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: derived from two separately fertilized eggs

examples.en: Dizygotic twins develop from two separate eggs fertilized by different sperm.
examples.zh: 异卵双胞胎是由两个不同的卵子分别受精发育而成的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 dizygotic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: loud enough to shake the very earth

examples.en: The scientist announced an earthshaking discovery that could change modern medicine forever.
examples.zh: 这位科学家宣布了一项可能永远改变现代医学的惊人发现。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 earthshaking 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a diplomat of the highest rank; accredited as representative from one country to another

examples.en: The king sent an embassador to the neighboring kingdom to negotiate peace.
examples.zh: 国王派遣使节前往邻国商讨和平事宜。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 embassador 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a brief stanza concluding certain forms of poetry

examples.en: The poet concluded his ballad with a brief envoi addressed to the prince.
examples.zh: 诗人在叙事诗末尾加了一段简短的结语献给王子。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 envoi 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the suppression of a gene by the effect of an unrelated gene

examples.en: Researchers studied epistasis to see how one gene masked another's expression.
examples.zh: 研究人员通过研究上位显性，观察一个基因如何掩盖另一个基因的表达。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 epistasis 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a trellis on which ornamental shrub or fruit tree is trained to grow flat

examples.en: The gardener trained the apple tree against the sunny stone wall as an espalier.
examples.zh: 园丁将苹果树修剪成平展的树形，紧贴着向阳的石墙生长。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 espalier 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 接近, 近亲关系, 类似
lemmas.def_en: the property of being close together

examples.en: Their daily propinquity in the small office naturally fostered a close friendship.
examples.zh: 他们在狭小办公室里的朝夕相处自然催生了亲密的友谊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 propinquity 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a spirally grooved spindle in a clock that counteracts the diminishing power of the uncoiling mainspring

examples.en: The stranded driver lit a bright red fusee to warn approaching motorists.
examples.zh: 遇险被困的司机点燃了一支亮红色的防风信号火柴以警告来车。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 fusee 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: very small North American and South American warblers

examples.en: We spotted a tiny gnatcatcher flitting through the branches in search of insects.
examples.zh: 我们发现一只小巧的蚋莺在树枝间穿梭捕食昆虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 gnatcatcher 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several perennial grasses of the genus Spartina; some important as coastal soil binders

examples.en: Dense patches of cordgrass protect the coastal shoreline from severe ocean erosion.
examples.zh: 茂密的米草丛保护着海岸线免遭严峻的海浪侵蚀。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cordgrass 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a woman who engages in sexual intercourse for money

examples.en: The famous French novel depicted the luxurious yet tragic life of a nineteenth-century cocotte.
examples.zh: 这部著名的法国小说描绘了一位19世纪交际花奢华而悲惨的生活。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cocotte 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: large European sandpiper with greenish legs

examples.en: A solitary greenshank waded through the shallow marsh, hunting for small fish.
examples.zh: 一只落单的青足鹬在浅泥沼中涉水捕食小鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 greenshank 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 一种黄檀属之树（产于热带美洲）
lemmas.def_en: a valuable timber tree of tropical South America

examples.en: The artisan crafted the acoustic guitar using beautiful, rich cocobolo wood.
examples.zh: 工匠采用美观华贵的黄檀木制作了这把原声吉他。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cocobolo 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several Asian and North American conifers of the genera Thuja and Thujopsis

examples.en: They planted a dense row of arborvitae along the fence for privacy.
examples.zh: 他们沿着栅栏种了一排茂密的侧柏作为隐私屏障。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 arborvitae 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a highly unstable radioactive element (the heaviest of the halogen series); a decay product of uranium and thorium

examples.en: Astatine is an extremely rare and highly radioactive element in the halogen group.
examples.zh: 砹是卤素族中一种极为稀有且具有高度放射性的元素。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 astatine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one quintillionth (10^-18) of a second; one thousandth of a femtosecond

examples.en: Specialized laser pulses can measure electron movements on the scale of an attosecond.
examples.zh: 特制激光脉冲可以在阿托秒的时间尺度上测量电子运动。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 attosecond 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: originating within the body

examples.en: She practiced autogenic training every evening to relax her muscles and relieve stress.
examples.zh: 她每天傍晚练习自律训练法，以放松肌肉并缓解压力。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 autogenic 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a retraction of a previously held position

examples.en: The government's sudden backdown on the controversial policy surprised the public.
examples.zh: 政府在该争议政策上的突然退让让公众大为惊讶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 backdown 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 宝大锦, 织锦, 华盖
lemmas.def_en: ornamented canopy supported by columns or suspended from a roof or projected from a wall (as over an altar)

examples.en: A magnificent marble baldachin rose high above the cathedral's central altar.
examples.zh: 大教堂中央祭坛上方高耸着一座宏伟的大理石华盖。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 baldachin 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 书市，书展，书籍展销会，图书博览会；图书大拍卖，书籍义卖
lemmas.def_en: fair organized by publishers or booksellers to promote the sale of books

examples.en: Thousands of eager readers gathered downtown for the annual international bookfair.
examples.zh: 成千上万热情的读者聚集在市中心参加一年一度的国际书展。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 bookfair 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a telegram sent abroad

examples.en: He urgently sent a cablegram overseas to notify his family of the emergency.
examples.zh: 他紧急发了一封海底电报到海外，通知家人这起突发事件。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cablegram 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 鞍后的弓起部分, 截剩的一片
lemmas.def_en: the back of a saddle seat

examples.en: The rider rested her hand on the high cantle of the leather saddle.
examples.zh: 骑手把手放在皮鞍后部高耸的鞍尾上。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cantle 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: being abruptly enlarged and globose at the tip

examples.en: The wildflower is easily recognized by its dense, round, capitate flower head.
examples.zh: 这种野花因其紧密而圆润的头状花序而极易辨认。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 capitate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I, T] (archaic) To worry, fret, or burden with anxiety.

examples.en: Do not let minor career setbacks cark your mind and ruin your weekend.
examples.zh: 不要让工作上的小挫折使你忧虑并毁了周末。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cark 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: North American annual plant with usually yellow or orange flowers; grows chiefly on wet rather acid soil

examples.en: Bright yellow celandine flowers bloomed along the damp, shaded path in the woods.
examples.zh: 亮黄色的白屈菜在树林间潮湿阴凉的小径旁盛开。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 celandine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a series of chirps

examples.en: The cheerful chirrup of morning sparrows woke him up before the alarm rang.
examples.zh: 早晨麻雀欢快的吱喳声在闹钟响起前就唤醒了他。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 chirrup 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 委陵菜, 五瓣花饰, 五瓣花图案
lemmas.def_en: any of a numerous plants grown for their five-petaled flowers; abundant in temperate regions; alleged to have medicinal properties

examples.en: The architect carved a delicate cinquefoil pattern above the ancient cathedral entrance.
examples.zh: 建筑师在古老大教堂的入口上方雕刻了精致的五瓣花图案。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 cinquefoil 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 雇用的一群喝采者, 一群谄媚者, 一群捧场者
lemmas.def_en: a group of followers hired to applaud at a performance

examples.en: The nervous opera singer hired a claque to ensure enthusiastic applause after her performance.
examples.zh: 这位紧张的歌剧演员雇了一群捧场者，以确保演出后获得热烈掌声。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 claque 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [I] (+ around/up/down) To walk with heavy, loud, clumsy steps.

examples.en: He heard the tired workers clomp down the wooden hallway in their heavy boots.
examples.zh: 他听到疲惫的工人们穿着沉重的靴子重重地走过木制走廊。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 clomp 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: perennial herb of northeastern United States having a thick knotted yellow rootstock and large rounded leaves

examples.en: She drank an herbal tea brewed with goldenseal to help soothe her sore throat.
examples.zh: 她喝了用白毛茛泡制的草药茶，以缓解喉咙痛。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 goldenseal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a warm dry wind that blows down the northern slopes of the Alps

examples.en: The dry foehn wind blew down the mountain, causing the snow to melt rapidly.
examples.zh: 干燥的焚风吹下山坡，导致积雪迅速融化。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 foehn 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: small slender African monkey having long hind limbs and tail and long hair around the face

examples.en: A colorful guenon leaped agilely through the dense canopy of the African rainforest.
examples.zh: 一只色彩鲜艳的长尾猴在非洲雨林茂密的树冠间敏捷地跳跃。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guenon 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any plant of the genus Monstera; often grown as houseplants

examples.en: The vibrant green monstera plant in the living room corner added a tropical touch.
examples.zh: 客厅角落里郁郁葱葱的蓬莱蕉为房间增添了热带风情。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monstera 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: one ten thousandth of a centner

examples.en: The laboratory balance accurately measured the tiny chemical residue down to a single myg.
examples.zh: 实验室的天平精确测量了微量化学残留物，精度达到一米克。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 myg 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a short news announcement concerning some on-going news story

examples.en: A sudden newsbreak interrupted the regular television broadcast with reports of the earthquake.
examples.zh: 一条突发新闻事件打断了正常的电视广播，报道了地震消息。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 newsbreak 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 街头流浪儿, 穷途末路的人
lemmas.def_en: a child who spends most of his time in the streets especially in slum areas

examples.en: The wealthy merchant looked down upon the poor guttersnipe begging on the dirty street.
examples.zh: 富商轻视那个在肮脏街道上乞讨的贫穷流浪儿。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 guttersnipe 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a bid that is higher than preceding bids

examples.en: Her aggressive overbid at the art auction shocked rival collectors in the hall.
examples.zh: 她在艺术品拍卖会上的过高出价震惊了展厅内的其他收藏家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 overbid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the study of fossil plants

examples.en: His deep passion for paleobotany led him to study ancient plant fossils worldwide.
examples.zh: 他对古植物学的深厚热情驱使他研究世界各地的古代植物化石。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paleobotany 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the study of the geography of ancient times or ancient epochs

examples.en: Through paleogeography, scientists can reconstruct how prehistoric continents moved over millions of years.
examples.zh: 通过古地理学，科学家能够重构数百万年来史前大陆是如何移动的。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 paleogeography 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （赛马中）前三名赢家分享（除赌场抽头提成外）的全部赌金的方法；（按赌金分享法）计算赌金的机器
lemmas.def_en: betting where winners share the total amount wagered

examples.en: He placed a bet on the race through the track's licensed parimutuel betting window.
examples.zh: 他在赛道特许的同注分彩投注窗口对这场比赛下了注。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parimutuel 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 镶木细工, 镶木地板
lemmas.def_en: a patterned wood inlay used to cover a floor

examples.en: The grand ballroom featured an intricate geometric parquetry floor made of polished oak.
examples.zh: 大宴会厅铺设了由抛光橡木制成的精致几何镶木地板。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 parquetry 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 猪般的, 馋嘴的, 贪心的, 邋遢的
lemmas.def_en: resembling swine; coarsely gluttonous or greedy

examples.en: His piggish behavior at the buffet table thoroughly disgusted all the other dinner guests.
examples.zh: 他在自助餐桌上贪婪馋嘴的表现让其他所有宾客深感厌恶。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 piggish 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 甜辣椒, 灯笼椒, 鲜红色
lemmas.def_en: plant bearing large mild thick-walled usually bell-shaped fruits; the principal salad peppers

examples.en: She garnished the freshly made potato salad with thin strips of sweet red pimiento.
examples.zh: 她用几根甜红辣椒丝点缀了刚做好的土豆沙拉。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pimiento 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: northern Atlantic sea poacher

examples.en: The researcher caught a small pogge hidden among the rocks along the cold seabed.
examples.zh: 研究人员在寒冷海床的岩石间捕获了一条隐蔽的小八角鱼。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pogge 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a permanent executive committee in socialist countries that has all the powers of some larger legislative body and that acts for it when it is not in session

examples.en: The supreme praesidium convened an emergency meeting to discuss the nationwide economic crisis.
examples.zh: 最高主席团召开了紧急会议，以讨论全国性的经济危机。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 praesidium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 屁股着地的摔倒, 丢脸的失误
lemmas.def_en: a fall onto your buttocks

examples.en: The arrogant politician took a humiliating pratfall during his live television debate.
examples.zh: 那位傲慢的政客在电视直播辩论中出了个丢人的大丑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 pratfall 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a flammable gas obtained by cracking petroleum; used in organic synthesis

examples.en: Propene is an important industrial chemical widely used to manufacture various commercial plastics.
examples.zh: 丙烯是一种重要的工业化学品，广泛用于制造各种商用塑料。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 propene 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [鸟]翠鸰(产于中南美的翠鸟状绿色热带鸟)
lemmas.def_en: tropical American bird resembling a blue jay and having greenish and bluish plumage

examples.en: A colorful motmot perched quietly on the branch, swinging its unique racket-shaped tail.
examples.zh: 一只色彩斑斓的翠鸰静静停在树枝上，摆动着独特的球拍状尾巴。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 motmot 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: morally offensive

examples.en: The kitchen was filled with the odoriferous scent of garlic and roasting spices.
examples.zh: 厨房里弥漫着大蒜和烘烤香料散发出的浓烈气味。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 odoriferous 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 独唱颂歌, 无伴奏齐唱, 挽歌
lemmas.def_en: music consisting of a single vocal part (usually with accompaniment)

examples.en: The poet composed a mournful monody to lament the untimely death of his friend.
examples.zh: 诗人写了一首哀婉的挽歌，哀悼友人不幸早逝。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 monody 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 必胜鸟类, 极乐鸟之一种
lemmas.def_en: large American flycatcher

examples.en: A fierce kingbird aggressively chased the larger hawk away from its nesting territory.
examples.zh: 一只凶猛的必胜鸟奋力将体型更大的鹰赶出了筑巢领地。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 kingbird 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a wrestling hold in which the opponent's arm is twisted up behind his back

examples.en: The wrestler secured a tight hammerlock, forcing his opponent to submit almost immediately.
examples.zh: 摔跤手牢牢锁住了对方的手臂，迫使其几乎立刻认输。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hammerlock 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large African antelope with lyre-shaped horns that curve backward

examples.en: A herd of hartebeest grazed peacefully across the vast golden plains of the Serengeti.
examples.zh: 一群大羚羊在塞伦盖蒂辽阔的金黄原野上安静地吃草。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hartebeest 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 有硬毛的, 多刚毛的
lemmas.def_en: (of animals or plants) having stiff coarse hairs or bristles

examples.en: Be careful when handling that plant because its hispid stems can irritate sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 拿取那株植物时要小心，因为它的刚毛茎会刺激敏感皮肤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 hispid 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 不知悔改的, 顽固的
lemmas.def_en: not penitent or remorseful

examples.en: Despite overwhelming evidence against him, the thief remained completely impenitent in the courtroom.
examples.zh: 尽管铁证如山，那个盗贼在法庭上依然毫无悔改之意。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 impenitent 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 无法仿效地, 独特地
lemmas.def_en: in an unreproducible manner

examples.en: She delivered the final comedic monologue inimitably, leaving the entire audience in stitches.
examples.zh: 她以无可仿效的独特方式讲完了最后的喜剧独白，逗得全场捧腹大笑。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 inimitably 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [法] 可保险性, 应当保险
lemmas.def_en: the quality of being insurable; the conditions under which an insurance company will issue insurance to an applicant (based on standards set by the insurance company)

examples.en: The doctor reviewed his medical history to determine his insurability for a new policy.
examples.zh: 医生查阅了他的病史，以评估他投保新保单的可保险性。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 insurability 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: existing or occurring between the sexes

examples.en: Biologists studied the intersexual differences in feeding behaviors among the newly discovered species.
examples.zh: 生物学家研究了这一新物种在摄食行为上的雌雄两性差异。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 intersexual 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: toward home

examples.en: Tired after a long journey, the weary travelers turned homewards as darkness fell.
examples.zh: 经过长途跋涉后疲惫不堪的旅客在夜幕降临时启程返家。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 homewards 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: (of tempo) less slow and broad than largo

examples.en: The orchestra gently shifted into a graceful larghetto movement that calmed the room.
examples.zh: 管弦乐队轻柔地转入优美的稍缓板乐章，使全场安静下来。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 larghetto 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 米哈拉布(意译为"祭坛"或"壁龛", 指清真寺正殿纵深处墙正中间指示麦加方向的小拱门或小阁)
lemmas.def_en: (Islam) a design in the shape of niche in a Muslim prayer rug; during worship the niche must be pointed toward Mecca

examples.en: Worshipers faced the ornate mihrab to pray in the direction of the holy city.
examples.zh: 信徒们面朝华丽的米哈拉布壁龛，朝圣城的方向祈祷。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mihrab 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [化] 林旦; 林丹; 高丙体666
lemmas.def_en: a white crystalline powder used as an agricultural insecticide

examples.en: The agricultural use of lindane was banned due to its high toxicity to wildlife.
examples.zh: 由于对野生动物具有高毒性，林丹在农业上的使用已被禁止。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 lindane 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a large edible clam found burrowing deeply in sandy mud along the Pacific coast of North America; weighs up to six pounds; has siphons that can extend to several feet and cannot be withdrawn into the shell

examples.en: The chef skillfully prepared the giant geoduck into delicate slices of fresh sashimi.
examples.zh: 厨师娴熟地将巨大的女神蛤切成一片片精致鲜美的生鱼片。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 geoduck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: pertaining to legal aspects of the practice of medicine (as malpractice or patient consent for operations or patient information)

examples.en: The forensic pathologist provided crucial medicolegal evidence during the high-profile murder trial.
examples.zh: 法医病理学家在那场备受瞩目的谋杀案审判中提供了关键的法医学证据。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 medicolegal 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: （给入侵私人领地者设的）捕人陷阱
lemmas.def_en: a very attractive or seductive looking woman

examples.en: The poacher was severely injured when he accidentally stepped into an ancient iron mantrap.
examples.zh: 那个偷猎者不小心踩进一个古老的铁制捕人陷阱，受了重伤。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 mantrap 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: self-indulgent sexual desire (personified as one of the deadly sins)

examples.en: The preacher warned the wealthy congregation against the perils of moral decay and luxuria.
examples.zh: 传教士警告富有的会众谨防道德沦丧和荒淫纵欲的危害。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 luxuria 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: 1. [T] (formal / archaic) To announce, proclaim, or herald solemnly.

examples.en: The government spokesman stepped up to the podium to annunciate the historic peace treaty.
examples.zh: 政府发言人走上讲台，正式宣告签署具有历史意义的和平条约。

lemmas.def_en: an indicator that announces which electrical circuit has been active (as on a telephone switchboard)

family_guide.root_logic: 以 annunciate 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 柳条制品, 柳条编制品
lemmas.def_en: work made of interlaced slender branches (especially willow branches)

examples.en: She kept her sewing supplies neatly organized inside a charming, handcrafted wickerwork basket.
examples.zh: 她将缝纫用品整齐地收纳在一个精美的手工柳条编制篮子里。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 wickerwork 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the power to do work that is latent in a head of water

examples.en: The early textile mills relied entirely on waterpower to run their heavy machinery.
examples.zh: 早期的纺织厂完全依赖水力来运转其重型机械。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 waterpower 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 教区代表, 教区委员
lemmas.def_en: a man who is a member of a church vestry

examples.en: As a respected vestryman, he helped manage the local church's financial affairs.
examples.zh: 作为一名受人尊敬的教区委员，他协助管理当地教会的财务。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 vestryman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: tawny brown North American thrush noted for its song

examples.en: We listened to the ethereal, flute-like song of a veery in the woods.
examples.zh: 我们在树林里倾听威尔逊鸫那空灵如笛声般的鸣唱。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 veery 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: 瓶空, (火箭燃料箱中的)气隙, 损耗
lemmas.def_en: the amount that a container (as a wine bottle or tank) lacks of being full

examples.en: Inspectors checked the wine barrels to measure the ullage caused by natural evaporation.
examples.zh: 检查员检查了酒桶，以测量因自然蒸发而产生的损耗量。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 ullage 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: [药]三碘甲状腺氨酸( 用于治疗甲状腺机能减退)
lemmas.def_en: thyroid hormone similar to thyroxine but with one less iodine atom per molecule and produced in smaller quantity; exerts the same biological effects as thyroxine but is more potent and briefer

examples.en: The doctor ordered blood tests to check her levels of triiodothyronine and other hormones.
examples.zh: 医生安排了血液检查，以测定她体内的三碘甲状腺氨酸及其它激素水平。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 triiodothyronine 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a soft silvery metallic element of the rare earth group; isotope 170 emits X-rays and is used in small portable X-ray machines; it occurs in monazite and apatite and xenotime

examples.en: Thulium is one of the rarest elements used in portable medical X-ray devices.
examples.zh: 铥是用于便携式医用X射线设备中最稀有的元素之一。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 thulium 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: a narrow headband or strip of ribbon worn as a headband

examples.en: The veterinarian prescribed medicine to rid the infected puppy of the harmful tenia.
examples.zh: 兽医开了药，以清除受感染小狗体内的有害绦虫。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 tenia 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: the person who steers a ship

examples.en: The experienced steersman kept the fishing boat steady through the rough ocean waves.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的舵手使渔船在汹涌的海浪中保持平稳。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 steersman 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_en: any of several large African antelopes of the genus Kobus having curved ridged horns and frequenting e.g. swamps and rivers

examples.en: A thirsty waterbuck grazed cautiously near the edge of the swampy African river.
examples.zh: 一只口渴的非洲大羚羊在非洲沼泽河边谨慎地吃草。

family_guide.root_logic: 以 waterbuck 为核心的派生词族。

lemmas.def_zh: <口> (尤指在影片等中的)色情利用
lemmas.def_en: the commercial exploitation of sex or sexuality or explicit sexual material
